meta.title: 3D variable-mass, multi-stage rocket ascent model (liftoff to atmosphere exit)
meta.units: SI (m, kg, s, N, Pa, K, rad unless a name ends in _deg)
meta.scope: Powered ascent from the launch pad until the vehicle leaves the sensible atmosphere (nominal exit h = 120 km; Karman line 100 km is logged as an event). Orbit insertion is outside the scope.
meta.model_type: Hybrid system: continuous ODEs (7 states) + discrete events (ignition, burnout, separation, fairing jettison, termination).
meta.primary_frame: ECI (Earth-Centred Inertial); atmosphere rotates rigidly with the Earth.
assumptions: Spherical Earth of radius R_E for altitude and local frame (WGS-84 ellipsoid is a listed extension).
Gravity = point mass + J2 term; no third-body, no tides.
Atmosphere: US Standard 1976 up to 86 km geometric, isothermal exponential extrapolation above; no wind (wind is an optional term).
Vehicle is a point mass with 3 translational DOF; attitude is prescribed by the guidance law (thrust direction), angle of attack alpha = 0 during gravity turn so normal force N = 0.
Exhaust velocity is constant per engine in vacuum (Isp_vac); nozzle back-pressure loss -p_a*A_e is included.
Throttle tau(t) scales the propellant mass flow linearly; Isp_vac is constant with throttle.
Staging is instantaneous: the discarded mass leaves with the vehicle velocity (momentum conserved) unless a separation delta-v is specified.

Dropped stage is propagated as an independent ballistic body (constant mass m_dry_1, tumbling C_D = 1.0, reference area A_ref_drop), see equation E26. The reference area is that of the discarded stage, not of the whole rocket.

Spherical R_E is used for altitude while gravity includes J2 (an oblate-potential harmonic). This is the standard simplification: the altitude differs from the WGS-84 value by a few km at the launch latitude, the dynamics are unaffected. Switching to WGS-84 only for the h computation is a listed extension.

Thrust is clipped at T >= 0, but mdot_p keeps being consumed when the clip is active (mass would vanish with no thrust). It never happens for this vehicle (T > 0 throughout, logged as clip_count = 0); the implementation must assert or log a flag if T is ever clipped, e.g. with a heavily over-expanded nozzle or a large A_e.
The thrust direction is C0-continuous everywhere and C1-continuous at the end of the blend; the only derivative discontinuities are at t_v and are handled by an integration restart.
meta.example_vehicle_note: The example vehicle is a GENERIC two-stage LOX/RP-1 launcher with illustrative numbers. It is not a model of any real rocket.
changelog: 1.1: guidance E17/E18 replaced by a continuous steering law (smooth pitch-over + smooth blend into the gravity turn); no discontinuity in u_T.
1.1: dropped stage now has an explicit second IVP (E26) with its own reference area A_ref_drop.
1.1: throttle breakpoints and the pitch-over start declared as non-terminal integration restarts.
1.1: documented thrust clipping, the |v_rel|->0 guard, the spherical-Earth + J2 inconsistency and the fairing heat-flux threshold.
1.1: example results regenerated with the corrected model (DOP853, same tolerances).

R_E.name: Earth radius (mean, spherical model)
R_E.definition: Radius used to turn |r| into altitude

g0.name: Standard gravity
g0.definition: Conversion constant in Isp definition (not local g)

q_heat_fairing.name: Free-molecular heat-flux threshold
q_heat_fairing.definition: Fairing is jettisoned when 0.5*rho*|v_rel|^3 falls below it (and h > 60 km). It is a design/tuning parameter: 1135 W/m^2 is low (0.5*rho*V^3 with rho ~ 1e-7 kg/m^3 and V ~ 3000 m/s is already ~1350 W/m^2), so in this example the fairing leaves late, near 110 km, just before the end of the model.

coordinate_frames.ECI: Origin at Earth centre; X_I toward vernal equinox (or any fixed direction), Z_I along spin axis, Y_I = Z_I x X_I. Inertial: Newton's laws apply directly.
coordinate_frames.ECEF: Same origin, rotates with Earth: r_ecef = R_z(-omega_E t) r_eci. Used to define the launch site and to draw trajectories relative to the ground.
coordinate_frames.ENU_local: Local triad at position r: up u = r/|r|, east e = (Z_I x u)/|Z_I x u|, north n = u x e. Used to define thrust pitch and azimuth.
coordinate_frames.launch_site_at_t0: ECI and ECEF coincide at t = 0 by convention (longitude lon0 measured from X_I).

state_variables.name: Instantaneous total mass
state_variables.definition: Everything currently attached to the vehicle: payload + fairing + all remaining stages (dry + propellant)

state_variables.name: Active stage index
state_variables.definition: Discrete variable, 1..N; changes only at separation events

kinematics_and_geometry.name: Local up, east, north unit vectors
Launch azimuth
kinematics_and_geometry.definition: Heading of the horizontal thrust component, clockwise from north

kinematics_and_geometry.name: Target orbital inclination
kinematics_and_geometry.definition: Used to compute the launch azimuth

kinematics_and_geometry.name: State of the dropped stage
kinematics_and_geometry.definition: [r_s(3), v_s(3)] ECI, started at EV3 from the vehicle state

mass_and_staging.name: Number of stages
mass_and_staging.definition: Stages are numbered in firing order

mass_and_staging.name: Dry (structural) mass of stage j
mass_and_staging.definition: Everything of stage j that is not propellant (tanks, engines, interstage)

mass_and_staging.name: Loaded propellant mass of stage j
Remaining propellant of the active stage
Mass at ignition of stage k
mass_and_staging.definition: Total vehicle mass at the start of burn k

mass_and_staging.name: Mass at burnout of stage k

propulsion.name: Throttle setting
propulsion.definition: 0..1; piecewise-linear table in time (example: max-Q bucket)

propulsion.name: Nominal propellant mass flow of stage k
Actual propellant mass flow
propulsion.definition: tau * mdot_max_k  (zero when engine is off)

propulsion.name: Vacuum specific impulse
propulsion.definition: Thrust per unit weight flow in vacuum

propulsion.name: Vacuum thrust at tau = 1
propulsion.definition: Rated vacuum thrust of all engines of stage k

propulsion.name: Total nozzle exit area
propulsion.definition: Sum over engines of stage k

propulsion.name: Thrust magnitude
propulsion.definition: mdot_p * v_e - p_a * A_e, clipped at >= 0 (clipping flagged in the log; mdot_p is not reduced when clipped)

propulsion.name: Thrust unit vector (body axis)
propulsion.definition: Output of the guidance law (continuous in time)

propulsion.name: Pitch-over angle from local vertical
propulsion.definition: Smooth kick law delta_max*(1-exp(-(t-t_v)/tau_pitch)), applied in the azimuth plane

aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.name: Aerodynamic reference area
aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.definition: Frontal area of the core (pi d^2 / 4)

aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.name: Angle of attack
aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.definition: Angle between body axis u_T and v_rel (0 for a gravity turn)

aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.name: Reference area of the dropped stage
aerodynamics_and_atmosphere.definition: Cross-section of discarded stage 1 used for its ballistic drag (here equal to the core cross-section, pi d^2/4 with the same d as A_ref)

performance_and_diagnostics.name: Back-pressure loss
performance_and_diagnostics.definition: integral of p_a A_e / m dt

equations.name: Translational dynamics (variable mass)
equations.latex: m\,\dot{\mathbf v}=\mathbf T+\mathbf D+\mathbf N+m\,\mathbf g(\mathbf r)
equations.notes: Obtained from momentum balance of a body that expels mass with exhaust velocity u_e relative to itself: m dv/dt = F_ext + (dm/dt) u_e. The term (dm/dt) u_e is the thrust, see E8.

equations.name: Mass bookkeeping
equations.expression: m = payload + fairing + sum_{j>k}(dry_j+prop_j) + dry_k + prop_k(t)

equations.name: Thrust with back-pressure
equations.notes: General form T = mdot_p*v_e + (p_e - p_a)*A_e; with p_e*A_e proportional to mdot_p this collapses to the vacuum thrust minus p_a*A_e. The max(.,0) clip is valid for this vehicle (T stays > 0 in the whole flight, clip_count = 0), but note that if T is clipped mdot_p keeps being consumed while the net thrust is 0: propellant would be burned with no effect. Implementations must assert or log a flag when the clip is active, especially with an over-expanded nozzle or a large A_e.

equations.name: ISA temperature and pressure (layer b)
equations.expression: see atmosphere_model.layers; above 86 km: isothermal exponential

equations.name: Local frame
equations.latex: \hat{\mathbf u}=\dfrac{\mathbf r}{|\mathbf r|},\quad\hat{\mathbf e}=\dfrac{\hat{\mathbf z}\times\hat{\mathbf u}}{|\hat{\mathbf z}\times\hat{\mathbf u}|},\quad\hat{\mathbf n}=\hat{\mathbf u}\times\hat{\mathbf e}

equations.name: Vertical rise and smooth pitch-over (programmed thrust direction)
equations.expression: u_T_prog = cos(d)*u + sin(d)*(cos(psi)*n + sin(psi)*e); d = 0 for t<t_v, d = d_max*(1-exp(-(t-t_v)/tau_pitch)) for t>=t_v
equations.notes: Replaces the former linear ramp with a hard stop. delta is continuous at t_v; only its slope jumps there, so t_v is declared as a restart point. Applied in the azimuth plane.

equations.name: Continuous hand-over to the gravity turn (zero angle of attack)
equations.expression: u_T = slerp(u_T_prog, v_rel/|v_rel|, s(t)); s = 3x^2-2x^3, x = clip((t-t_blend0)/t_blend, 0, 1); s=1 gives the pure gravity turn u_T = v_rel/|v_rel|
equations.notes: Entering the gravity turn is no longer an event: u_T is continuous and, because s'(0)=s'(1)=0, its derivative is continuous too. Singularity guard: if |v_rel| < 1e-3 m/s use the previous u_T (the programmed direction u_T_prog) instead of v_rel/|v_rel|; it does not trigger in the example (|v_rel| ~ 150 m/s at t = 16 s) but avoids NaN for slower vehicles. If u_T_prog and v_rel are almost parallel, slerp falls back to a normalised linear mix.

equations.name: Initial conditions
equations.expression: r0 = R_E*u0; v0 = cross(omega, r0); m(0) = total liftoff mass

equations.name: Staging jump map (stage k -> k+1)
equations.latex: \mathbf r^+=\mathbf r^-,\quad m^+=m^--m_{dry,k},\quad \mathbf v^+=\mathbf v^-+\dfrac{m_{dry,k}}{m^-}\,\Delta v_{sep}\,\hat{\mathbf u}_T
equations.expression: r+ = r-; m+ = m- - m_dry_k; v+ = v- + (m_dry_k/m-)*dv_sep*u_T
equations.notes: From momentum conservation m- v- = m+ v+ + m_dry (v+ - dv_sep u_T). With dv_sep = 0 the velocity is continuous and only the mass jumps.

equations.name: Fairing jettison jump map
equations.expression: m+ = m- - m_fair when 0.5*rho*Vr^3 < 1135 W/m^2 (after max-Q)
equations.notes: The heat-flux threshold (1135 W/m^2) is a tuning parameter and is quite low, so the fairing leaves late (~110 km in the example).

equations.name: Delta-v budget closure
equations.latex: |\mathbf v_f|-|\mathbf v_0|=\Delta v_{ideal}-\Delta v_{bp}-\Delta v_{steer}-\Delta v_{drag}-\Delta v_{grav}
equations.expression: exact identity from d|v|/dt = (T.v_hat + D.v_hat)/m + g.v_hat

equations.name: Diagnostics
equations.latex: h=|\mathbf r|-R_E,\quad n=\dfrac{|\mathbf T+\mathbf D+\mathbf N|}{m\,g_0},\quad \varepsilon=\dfrac{|\mathbf v|^2}{2}-\dfrac{\mu}{|\mathbf r|}

equations.name: Dropped stage (second, independent IVP)
equations.latex: \dot{\mathbf r}_s=\mathbf v_s,\quad \dot{\mathbf v}_s=\mathbf g(\mathbf r_s)-\dfrac{\tfrac12\,\rho(h_s)\,C_D\,A_{ref,drop}\,|\mathbf v_{s,air}|\,\mathbf v_{s,air}}{m_{dry,1}},\quad \mathbf v_{s,air}=\mathbf v_s-\boldsymbol\omega_E\times\mathbf r_s
equations.expression: dr_s/dt = v_s;  dv_s/dt = g(r_s) - 0.5*rho(h_s)*C_D(1.0)*A_ref_drop*|v_s_air|*v_s_air/m_dry_1;  v_s_air = v_s - cross([0,0,omega_E], r_s)
equations.notes: Started at EV3 with y_sep = [r, v, m_dry_1] taken from the vehicle state before the mass jump (dv_sep = 0). Terminated when h_s = |r_s| - R_E <= 0 (impact). Uses the same g(r) (point mass + J2) and rho(h) as the main model. A_ref_drop is the reference area of the discarded stage, not the A_ref of the complete rocket. If the impact point is not needed, this block can be removed from the spec.

atmosphere_model.above_86km: Isothermal at T = 186.946 K with exponential pressure decay, scale height R_air*T/g0 = 5.47 km

phase_2_pitch_kick.description: Smooth pitch-over (E17) starting at t_v, no hard end
phase_2_pitch_kick.plane: azimuth plane (cos psi * n + sin psi * e)
phase_2_pitch_kick.note: delta_max was re-tuned from 5.0 deg (old linear ramp, which reached 5 deg at 16 s) to 5.4 deg so the trajectory stays close to v1.0; the old law is not equivalent and the trajectory is very sensitive to it (a few tenths of a degree change the exit altitude/FPA a lot).

phase_3_gravity_turn.thrust_direction: smooth blend (E18) from the programmed direction into the air-relative velocity unit vector (alpha = 0)
phase_3_gravity_turn.applies_to: rest of the ascent, both stages
phase_3_gravity_turn.singularity_guard: if |v_rel| < 1e-3 m/s: use previous u_T (programmed direction)

events_and_staging.name: Stage-1 separation
events_and_staging.action: apply jump map E20: m -= m_dry_1; k = 2; start the ballistic IVP E26 for the dropped stage

events_and_staging.name: Pitch-over start (integration restart)
events_and_staging.action: non-terminal event, direction = 0: restart the step at the slope discontinuity of delta(t)

events_and_staging.name: Throttle breakpoint t = 44 s
events_and_staging.trigger: t = 44 s (breakpoint of the tau table)
events_and_staging.action: terminal = False, direction = 0: restart the step exactly at the kink of tau(t); improves max-Q accuracy at no cost

events_and_staging.name: Throttle breakpoint t = 50 s
events_and_staging.trigger: t = 50 s (breakpoint of the tau table)
events_and_staging.action: terminal = False, direction = 0: restart the step exactly at the kink of tau(t); improves max-Q accuracy at no cost

events_and_staging.name: Throttle breakpoint t = 66 s
events_and_staging.trigger: t = 66 s (breakpoint of the tau table)
events_and_staging.action: terminal = False, direction = 0: restart the step exactly at the kink of tau(t); improves max-Q accuracy at no cost

events_and_staging.name: Throttle breakpoint t = 72 s
events_and_staging.trigger: t = 72 s (breakpoint of the tau table)
events_and_staging.action: terminal = False, direction = 0: restart the step exactly at the kink of tau(t); improves max-Q accuracy at no cost

throttle_table.note: last time entry means 'to end of flight'

dropped_stage.note: Stage 1 is the core, with the same diameter as A_ref (pi d^2/4 = 10.52 m^2). If the real stage section is smaller (e.g. 7-8 m^2) change this value.

numerical_method.event_handling: terminal events stop the integration; jump map applied; integration restarts from the new state. Throttle breakpoints (44, 50, 66, 72 s) and the pitch-over start (10 s) are non-terminal events (terminal=False, direction=0) that restart the step exactly there.

logging_flags.thrust_clipped: log/assert if T was clipped at 0 (E8)
logging_flags.v_rel_guard: log if |v_rel| < 1e-3 m/s forced the previous u_T

events.event: Atmosphere exit (120 km) – end of model
